Alyosha (Russian: Алёша Alyosha) is a playable Electro character in Genshin Impact.

He is a renowned hunter hailing from the Snezhnayan tundra, operating alongside his companion Tugarin.

Hunter's Advance
Elemental Burst
  • Description
  • Advanced Properties
  • Attribute Scaling
  • Preview
Summons his trusted companion Tugarin to fight alongside him on the field. This also turns an area in front of him into a Fulgurite Hunting Field for a short time.

Fulgurite Hunting Field
  • Continuously taunts nearby opponents to incite them to attack.
  • Every 2s, deals an instance of AoE Electro DMG to any opponent that enters the field.

Tugarin
  • If there are any opponents nearby, Tugarin will quickly move close to an opponent and maul them every 2s, dealing Electro DMG
  • If an opponent affected by the Hunter's Mark effect is hit, the Hunter's Mark will also be activated.
  • Where there are multiple opponents, Tugarin will attack those affected by the Hunter's Mark effect first.

Increases the DMG Alyosha deals with his Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst by 0.35% for every 1% of his Energy Recharge. Up to a 70% increase can be obtained in this way.
Into the Fray
Passive
Alyosha will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state when inside a Polestar Field.
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: The Hunter's Precision effect obtained when the Hunter's Mark is activated will also increase Stellar-Conduct DMG dealt by all currently active party members by 20%.
Treetop Watch
Utility Passive
  • Description

Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Snezhnaya on the mini-map.

  • Alyosha must be in the active party for Treetop Watch to take effect, but he does not need to be alive.
  • Only one local specialty will be shown on the mini-map at a time.
  • The following Talent is identical to this talent:
    • Echo of Winter Daydreams (Odette)

Talent Demo[]

TitleDescription
Character SummaryAlyosha is an Electro character with both off-field DPS and healing capabilities. After his Elemental Burst is unleashed, he can also summon his hound companion Tugarin to the field.
Alyosha applies Hunter's Mark to opponents hit by the last strike of his Normal Attack or Elemental Skill. For some time after, should he then hit opponents affected by Hunter's Mark again with the last strike of his Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, or a Tugarin attack, nearby active party members will also have their on-field ATK increased.
After the Passive Talent "Awakened by the Baying Hounds" is unlocked, whenever Tugarin attacks the opponent, nearby active party members will also regenerate HP.
Elemental Skill: IWhen his Elemental Skill is unleashed, Alyosha applies Hunter's Mark to opponents hit. Should any of these marked opponents then be hit again by the final strike of Alyosha's Normal Attack or Elemental Skill, or take a hit from Tugarin, nearby party members will also have their on-field ATK increased for some time.

Additionally, each time Tugarin attacks the opponent, he will also apply the Hunter's Mark to a target. This effect does not activate existing Hunter's Marks.

When Tugarin attacks, he will also restore 60% of Alyosha's ATK as HP to the nearby party member with the lowest HP by percentage.

Maximum upgrade level is 15.
Standard Reclaimed

The Hunter's Precision effect obtained from activating a Hunter's Mark can now stack, max 2 stacks. When the stack count reaches 2, currently active party members will also have their Elemental Mastery increased by 100.
Each Constellation activation requires one Alyosha's Stella Fortuna.

  • All Character Event Wish and Weapon Event Wish since Version 7.1
  • Progress through the Archon Quest Gunfire in the Silent Lands in Chapter VII: Act I - Everwinter Without Mercy.
